queries: WITH account_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, c.town_city AS town, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM Accounts AS a JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.town_city) <> '' GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city), metrics AS (SELECT account_id, town, transaction_count, SUM(transaction_count) OVER (PARTITION BY town) AS town_transaction_count, AVG(transaction_count * 1.0) OVER () AS average_transaction_count FROM account_counts) SELECT account_id, town, transaction_count, transaction_count * 1.0 / town_transaction_count AS share_of_town_transactions, transaction_count * 1.0 / average_transaction_count AS ratio_to_average FROM metrics ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, account_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A blank or whitespace-only town counts as having no town; nonblank town values are grouped exactly as stored.
